items.myDerivation: D x!=0; no intercepts; f'=e^x(x-2)/x^3 inc x<0, dec (0,2), inc x>2; min (2,e^2/4~1.8473); f''=e^x(x^2-4x+6)/x^4>0 on both branches, no inflection; VA x=0 (+inf both sides); HA y=0 at -inf only; no asymptote at +inf
items.notes: Confirmed vs 24A-A p1: official part ג wrongly says y''<0 for x<0; f''=e^x(x^2-4x+6)/x^4>0 everywhere. Terminology: this solution uses the 24A convention (f''>0 = concave up, called קעורה); the 17A/17B/18B/19A items use the opposite word convention (f''>0 = קמורה).
